pattern: を押して / を押し切って（をおして / をおしきって）
aliases: をおして / をおしきって
purpose: Proceed despite difficulty or press past active opposition.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
N + を押して / を押し切って
He attended the ceremony despite being ill.
She carried out the plan over opposition.
I made the request knowing it would inconvenience you.
formation: N + を押して / を押し切って
restrictions: 押して often with illness or inconvenience; 押し切って often with opposition.
mistake: 押し切る suggests overcoming resistance more strongly.
